title: UAAP: Tams in good spot despite missing out on top seed after first round, says coach
summary: Sean Chambers believes the Far Eastern University Tamaraws are still in a good spot despite missing out on the top seed at the end of the first round of the UAAP Season 89 men's basketball tournament.
